# Playback & Experiência Cinematográfica Checklist: Player Cinematográfico de Quadros

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de exibição cinematográfica, avanço
automático e navegação (quadro a quadro, salto por cena, reinício) — são os requisitos
completos, claros, consistentes e mensuráveis?
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | Contrato: [player-ui-contract.md](../contracts/player-ui-contract.md) | Modelo: [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Completude dos Requisitos

- [x] CHK001 Are the start-of-experience requirements defined (whether the narrative begins automatically on load or requires an explicit action)? [Gap, Spec §US1] — auto-start visual + overlay quando autoplay bloqueado (FR-004, FR-017)
- [x] CHK002 Is the set of allowed transitions (cut, fade, zoom, etc.) enumerated, and is it defined whether the author selects the transition per frame, per scene, or per story? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002] — enum + precedência quadro > cena > história
- [x] CHK003 Is the end-of-narrative state specified (how the end is indicated and which actions remain available)? [Gap, Spec §US1] — estado `ended`, edge case e controles de revisão
- [x] CHK004 Are the semantics of "previous scene" defined (first frame of the previous scene vs first frame of the current scene) and the behavior at the first/last scene boundary? [Gap, Spec §FR-003] — UI contract + no-op nos limites (FR-003)
- [x] CHK005 Is the resume semantics after a pause defined (restart the frame's full duration vs continue the remaining time)? [Gap, Spec §FR-013] — quadro reinicia; áudio retoma (FR-013)
- [x] CHK006 Is the auto-advance behavior under `prefers-reduced-motion` specified (continue advancing with instant cuts vs pause entirely)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006] — continua com corte instantâneo (FR-011, UI contract)
- [x] CHK007 Is persistent visibility of the play/pause control specified with the same "always accessible" strength as the audio control? [Gap, Spec §FR-005/§FR-013] — barra persistente (UI contract)
- [x] CHK008 Is the behavior defined when manual navigation or a scene jump occurs mid-transition or under rapid repeated input? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — cancela/reposiciona; entradas coalescidas (FR-003)
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified whether the progress indicator is informative only or interactive (seek), and whether seeking is explicitly out of scope? [Gap, UI Contract §Controles visíveis] — informativo, não interativo
- [x] CHK010 Is "transição cinematográfica conforme a intenção narrativa" quantified with measurable properties (allowed types, duration ranges, easing)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — FR-002
- [x] CHK011 Is "ação" in SC-011 defined (what counts as one action) so the ≤3-action target is objectively measurable? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-011] — um toque/clique/tecla
- [x] CHK012 Is "proporcionalmente ao ritmo configurado" in SC-010 quantified with a tolerance or ratio? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010] — ±10%
- [x] CHK013 Is the baseline for SC-001 defined (event from which time is measured, automatic vs manual arrival at the second frame, device profile)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001] — resolvido: origem = navigation start até a exibição do segundo quadro (SC-001); 1x/1.500 ms; dispositivo definido
- [x] CHK014 Is "retomar do ponto onde parou" clarified as frame-level (not intra-frame) precision? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013] — nível de quadro
- [x] CHK015 Are minimum/maximum bounds or authoring guidance for author-defined frame durations specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-018] — 500–30.000 ms
- [x] CHK016 Do FR-018 ("por quadro ou por história") and the "Cena" entity/data model agree on scene-level duration override? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, Data-Model §Scene] — FR-018 agora inclui cena
- [x] CHK017 Can SC-001 (<10 s to the second frame) hold simultaneously with author-defined slow durations (FR-018), and is the precedence defined? [Conflict, Spec §SC-001/§FR-018] — precedência usuário > autor > SC-001
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-011 (reach the last frame in ≤3 actions) achievable with the defined control set, or does it require an unlisted "go to end"/seek control? [Conflict, Spec §SC-011, UI Contract] — `End` adicionado
- [x] CHK019 Do the requirements state that manual navigation pauses auto-advance as a first-class FR, rather than leaving it only in the data model/research? [Traceability, Spec §FR-017, Data-Model] — FR-003
- [x] CHK020 Is the tab-blur behavior consistent between the Edge Cases ("retoma ao voltar") and the player state model (resume requires explicit play)? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Data-Model] — pausa + overlay de retomada
- [x] CHK021 Are the keyboard shortcuts consistent between the UI contract key map and the functional requirements, and is the contract authoritative when shortcuts conflict with browser defaults? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, UI Contract] — precedência + `preventDefault`
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for degenerate narratives (a single frame, a single scene, or a single scene with many frames)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap] — edge case adicionado
- [x] CHK023 Is the behavior specified for "next" on the last frame and "previous" on the first frame? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-003] — no-op
- [x] CHK024 Is the initial state while the first frame is still loading specified (what the user perceives before the first frame appears)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-015] — placeholder + `aspect-ratio`
- [x] CHK025 Is the saved-progress update policy defined for automatic advancement (not only for pause/manual advance)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, Storage Contract] — FR-019 + storage contract
- [x] CHK026 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme established linking FR, SC, US, and contract rows? [Traceability] — IDs + Matriz de Rastreabilidade
- [x] CHK027 Does every control in the UI contract trace to a functional requirement, and does every navigation FR trace to a contract row? [Traceability, UI Contract] — resolvido: FR-034 criado para o indicador de progresso e contrato reapontado (FR-034)

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (2ª passada)**: CHK003 e CHK018 reabertos e resolvidos — FR-033 (estado final) e SC-011 reescrito.
- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (3ª passada, agente independente)**: CHK013 e CHK027 reabertos e **resolvidos** — origem de SC-001 definida (navigation start) e FR-034 criado para o indicador de progresso. Também corrigidos: `defaultFrameDurationMs` opcional (padrão 1500) tornando o fallback de 1.500 ms alcançável; piso de permanência efetiva de 250 ms; fallback de transição `fade` 600 ms; semântica de `ended` (navegação que altera posição sai do estado; no-op permanece); citação da pausa por perda de foco corrigida para FR-013.
